mapper.select:
select from cbs.t_cert
order by expire_date asc nulls last limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
mapper.insert: insert into cbs.t_cert (cert_id, cert_type, cert_name, cert_no, issue_org, issue_date, expire_date, warn_days, holder_name, holder_idcard, cert_scope, dept_code, creator, open_status) values (#{c.cert_id}, #{c.cert_type}, #{c.cert_name}, #{c.cert_no}, #{c.issue_org}, #{c.issue_date}, #{c.expire_date}, #{c.warn_days}, #{c.holder_name}, #{c.holder_idcard}, #{c.cert_scope}, #{c.dept_code}, #{c.creator}, #{c.open_status})
mapper.update: update cbs.t_cert set open_status = false where cert_id = #{id}
